question: The picture that won the World Press Photo of the Year 2021 contest is titled ‘_________’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The First Embrace.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The independent jury of the 2021 Photo Contest selected Mads Nissen’s photograph The First Embrace as the World Press Photo of the Year.**
 
• In the winning image, **Rosa Luzia Lunardi (85) is embraced by nurse Adriana Silva da Costa Souza, at Viva Bem care home, Sao Paulo, Brazil, on 5 August 2020.**

** [IMAGE: https://englishtribuneimages.blob.core.windows.net/gallary-content/2021/4/2021_4$largeimg_2079865872.JPG] **

 
• **The winners were announced at an online Awards Show on 15 April 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Press Photo Foundation presents the awards in the following categories:
 
 
• **World Press Photo of the Year.**
 
• **World Press Photo Story of the Year.**
 
• **World Press Photo Interactive of the Year. **
 
• **World Press Photo Online Video of the Year.**
 
 
 
• ​It all **began in 1955 when a group of Dutch photographers **organized an** international contest (“World Press Photo”) to expose their work to a global audience.**
 
• The** World Press Photo Contest recognizes the best photojournalism and documentary photography.**
 
• ​**​Amber Bracken's picture, entitled Kamloops Residential School, has been named World Press Photo of the Year, 2022.**
